map.A/B 测试点击率（CTR）统计显著性检验，计算 Z 值、P 值与置信区间: A/B click-through rate (CTR) statistical significance testing, computing the Z value, P value, and confidence interval
map.A/B 两组创意各给展示与点击数，算各自 CTR，初步看哪版更吸睛。: Give impressions and clicks for two A/B creative variants, compute each CTR, and see which catches the eye more.
map.用两比例 z 检验判断 CTR 差异是否统计显著，避免把随机波动当胜出。: Use a two-proportion z-test to judge whether the CTR difference is statistically significant, so random fluctuation is not mistaken for a winner.
map.样本不足时提示加大曝光或更换显著性水平，再下结论。: When the sample is insufficient, increase impressions or change the significance level before concluding.
map.两创意 CTR 显著性检验: Significance test for two creative CTRs
map.：A 组展示 10000、点击 500（CTR 5.0%）；B 组展示 1000: : group A had 10000 impressions and 500 clicks (CTR 5.0%); group B had 10000 impressions and 580 clicks (CTR 5.8%). The two-proportion z-test gives p ≈ 0.11 (not significant at α = 0.05), so the gap may be random; scale up to 30000+ impressions per group before deciding.
map.显著性水平 α 是什么？: What Is the Significance Level α?
map.α 是'误判差异显著'的可接受风险，常用 0.05（95% 置信）。α 越小越保: α is the acceptable risk of wrongly calling a difference significant, commonly 0.05 (95% confidence). A smaller α is more conservative and harder to reach significance. With small samples a high-looking CTR may still be insignificant because of high variance, so read it together with sample size.
map.样本量不够能下结论吗？: Can I Conclude with an Insufficient Sample?
map.不够时差异极易被噪声掩盖或放大。经验上每组至少数千曝光、数十次点击再检验较稳；未: No. With too little data, noise easily masks or inflates the difference. Empirically, a few thousand impressions and dozens of clicks per group make the test fairly stable; below that, treat the result as directional only and do not stop a creative on that basis.
